oracle.method: The adapter extracts the d13c236 distance/perpendicular gate verbatim. Correct results invoke the production ballistics module directly and compare 256 fixed seeds against pinned engine geom::scan and eval_tick.

legacy_results.legacy_failure: The old gate treats bot radius plus splash radius as a tube around the entire ray. Perpendicular distance 0.4 is below 0.55, although the radius-0.25 hull is never hit and the endpoint blast is far away.
The old centre projection requires along <= 10.0, so a centre at 10.2 is rejected even though its near hull intersects at 9.95.
The old preliminary centre-distance cutoff is 10.25, so it rejects the centre at 10.5 even though the endpoint blast covers it.
The old function never scans enemy hulls and returns only a Boolean. It cannot report that a nearer, protected enemy terminates the ray before the intended enemy.
The extracted old geometric gate passes, its target-centre has_line_of_sight check passes, and payload/deposit blocker checks are clear. The turn-limited actual ray instead enters wall tile (5,8).
The old Boolean return cannot express physical or currently damageable coverage sets. Its controller therefore cannot subtract already covered enemies when scoring the second shooter.

post_fix_test.eval_tick_tolerance_reason: The official eval_tick performs f32 collision cleanup before firing; the tolerance is the pinned engine EPSILON and the observed error is substantially smaller.
